long_biography.plain_text:
Koutsolioutsos studied finance in Milan after his family left Alexandria and rebuilt its livelihood in Greece. With Aikaterini Koutsolioutsou, he first tested her jewellery designs through small production runs and trade fairs. The couple then opened Folli Follie in central Athens in 1982, establishing a business around affordable jewellery, watches and fashion accessories.

As chairman and controlling shareholder, Koutsolioutsos led expansion beyond Greece, including an early push into Japan and later growth across Asia. The group listed in Athens, added travel retail and acquired Links of London, while his son George became chief executive. Founder control, international distribution and brand-building became the foundations of Koutsolioutsos's fortune.

Official filings use Dimitrios, while company and business profiles also use Dimitris. They identify the same founder-chairman and controlling shareholder. The dossier preserves the upstream display name and uses the familiar Dimitris form in prose without proposing a first-name correction.

Aikaterini or Ketty Koutsolioutsou is the documented wife and co-founder; Georgios, George or Tzortzis Koutsolioutsos is the documented son and later chief executive.
